name: Chicken and the Wolf
description: Tulsa's legendary Nashville hot chicken joint. Unbelievably crispy and juicy.

review.author: CaptainBrando!
review.text: THE BEST CHICKEN SANDWICH IN THE WORLD 🌏 Crispy fries and crispy, juicy, thick as a brick chicken. Perfection. Never going to chick fil a again. A medium OG chicken sandwich, regular fries with some extra comeback sauce, and a coop 66. Heavenly experience. The cure for depression. Dine in otherwise the fries will lose their glorious crispy exterior. And they ain't playing with the spice level! Hot is hot!

directions: Located right off historical Route 66 / S Lewis Ave. Ample street parking available.
bestDishes: OG Chicken Sandwich, medium spice, a side of regular fries and comeback sauce. A Coop 66. Eat in store, otherwise the fries get soggy quickly.
bestTimes: Weekday lunch hours to avoid the weekend rush.
moreInfo: Brings the true heat of Nashville straight to the heart of Tulsa. Safe dog patio dining is welcomed.

name: Oppa House Korean BBQ and Hot Pot
address: 7001 S Garnett Rd, Broken Arrow, OK 74012
description: Authentic tabletop grilling experience with premium cuts and hot pot options.

review.author: CaptainBrando!
review.text: Magnificent experience. I've been to a lot of hot pots, but I like this one the most. Delicious broth and bbq, with a lot of included extras! The chicken wings were SO luxurious and complimentary in the all-you-can-eat! 🍗 And the spicy pork bulgogi? Absolutely delicious! The churros were surprisingly excellent. And the hand pulled fresh ramen noodles? Just, damn! If this were heaven I'd eat here every day. Wow, blown away! Insane that I only paid around 30 per person for so much food! Great service great flavors great seats great time. This the best game in town.

directions: Sourced via local Google Maps links.
moreInfo: Links directly to user's personalized Google Maps review.

name: The Colony
description: Tulsa's historic Midtown dive bar and live music venue. Cozy pub interior and active outdoor patio.

review.author: CaptainBrando!
review.text: $4 shot and a beer. Artists bleeding on a stage. Always good folk on the patio.

name: Wings Over Rochester
description: Famous Rochester wing and tender spot known for massive, hand-breaded chicken tenders. The best chicken wings I've ever had.

review.author: CaptainBrando!
review.text: Cruisin Altitude 6 Tender Pack is the absolute way to go. Don't do bone-in or boneless here, trust me. The tenders are insanely good!
